title: Missing security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP)
description: Response headers lack Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy, and Referrer-Policy, making the application susceptible to clickjacking, MIME-type sniffing, and other attacks.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/login.php; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: Set-Cookie: PHPSESSID=oh7b9qbtd9c0dueninuaf8i9h1; path=/ Set-Cookie: security=low
